'''Zan Dane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] based out of [[Point Nadir]]. His background was a mystery, but he was well-versed in naval command. His accent was reminiscent of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

He was flamboyant and enjoyed the life of a pirate, but he was not bloodthirsty. He was honorable and mischievous. Dane preferred brightly colored red and blue clothes, and wore a finely tailored silk cloak and [[Vibrorapier/Legends|vibrorapier]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

He had a crew of more than 400 people and [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. His fleet consisted of two capital ships, six transports and a handful of starfighters. The two capital ships were the ''[[Amber Star]]'', a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], and the ''[[Sweet Victory]]'', a [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvette]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
